dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical geometric narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white median pixel intensity across the dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency clusters of dark pixels localized along the central longitudinal axis.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient boundaries between the dark midline clusters and the lighter dorsal skin canvas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct linear arrangement of small, high-contrast dark marks located along the mid-dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Linear series of dark spots/marks along the dorsal ridge, appearing as discrete points of contrast.
